purpose: Material source remediation after H.1.3 closed FAIL_MARKET_COVERAGE. Test The Odds API on a new independent holdout without changing frozen H coverage or temporal criteria.

denominator.source: Football-Data.co.uk 2025/26 completed league fixtures/results, independent of odds availability
denominator.fixture_eligibility: All completed men's full-time league fixtures with match date/kickoff inside the holdout window. Exclusions only for postponed/cancelled/abandoned/non-completed status; never exclude because The Odds API lacks an event id, bookmaker, market, line or price.
denominator.event_id_resolution: Resolve each denominator fixture to The Odds API historical event id by competition plus home/away teams plus kickoff/date. Unresolved provider event ids remain in denominator and count uncovered.

holdout.selection_rationale: Nearest full calendar month before the previously observed March holdout, same 2025/26 seasons, not used as an H.1.3 evaluation month, frozen before any The Odds API historical query.

candidate_bookmakers.selection_basis: Fixed before holdout from The Odds API official bookmaker registry; no holdout-driven substitution or ranking.
candidate_bookmakers.missing_bookmaker_rule: Missing bookmaker data is uncovered, not grounds for replacement.

market_contract.pair_reconstruction: For each bookmaker, market contract and half-point line independently, use the provider historical snapshot equal to or immediately before prediction_as_of. Require a two-sided Over/Under pair for the identical bookmaker, market, team where applicable, period and line. Provider/bookmaker/market timestamp or last_update must be nonfuture and each side age <=300 seconds. Prices must be >1 and valid.

gates.competition_market_pass: All three horizons PASS and at least one fixed candidate bookmaker admitted for the contract.
gates.zero_provider_event_rule: Fixture remains denominator and is uncovered.
gates.zero_market_rule: Fixture remains denominator and is uncovered.

cost_control.note: Actual cost can be lower when requested markets return no data because quota counts unique markets returned.

promotion.H_final_pass_requires: At least one competition/market contract PASS plus all infrastructure, temporal, raw-integrity, SQLite, test and restore gates PASS.
